entities.name: Francisco Cabañas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco Cabañas Pardo was a Mexican boxer. He competed in the flyweight class during the 1932 Summer Olympics and, although he lost the final against Hungarian István Énekes, he became the first Mexican athlete to ever win an individual Olympic medal.
